requirements.quote:
This case is a combination of the previous cases.  The zone does not
   contain an exact match for <SNAME, SCLASS>, and although the zone
   does contain RRsets that match <SNAME, SCLASS> via wildcard
   expansion, none of those RRsets matches STYPE.  The name server MUST
   include the following NSEC RRs in the Authority section, along with
   their associated RRSIG RRs:

   o  An NSEC RR proving that there are no RRsets matching STYPE at the
      wildcard owner name that matched <SNAME, SCLASS> via wildcard
      expansion.
requirements.condition: The zone has no exact match for <SNAME, SCLASS>, but has RRsets matching <SNAME, SCLASS> through wildcard expansion, and none of those RRsets matches STYPE.
requirements.required_behavior: The name server MUST include in the Authority section an NSEC RR proving that no RRsets matching STYPE exist at the wildcard owner name that matched <SNAME, SCLASS>.
requirements.why_checkable: A wildcard no-data response can be checked for an Authority-section NSEC RR that proves absence of the queried type at the matched wildcard owner.

requirements.quote:
This case is a combination of the previous cases.  The zone does not
   contain an exact match for <SNAME, SCLASS>, and although the zone
   does contain RRsets that match <SNAME, SCLASS> via wildcard
   expansion, none of those RRsets matches STYPE.  The name server MUST
   include the following NSEC RRs in the Authority section, along with
   their associated RRSIG RRs:

   o  An NSEC RR proving that there are no RRsets matching STYPE at the
      wildcard owner name that matched <SNAME, SCLASS> via wildcard
      expansion.

   o  An NSEC RR proving that there are no RRsets in the zone that would
      have been a closer match for <SNAME, SCLASS>.

   In some cases, a single NSEC RR may prove both of these points.  If
   it does, the name server SHOULD only include the NSEC RR and its
   RRSIG RR(s) once in the Authority section.
requirements.condition: The zone has no exact match for <SNAME, SCLASS>, but has RRsets matching <SNAME, SCLASS> through wildcard expansion, and none of those RRsets matches STYPE. A single NSEC RR proves both absence of STYPE at the matching wildcard owner and absence of a closer match.
requirements.required_behavior: The name server SHOULD include that NSEC RR only once in the Authority section.
requirements.why_checkable: When one NSEC RR establishes both required proofs, its occurrence count in the Authority section can be checked against the recommendation.

This case is a combination of the previous cases.  The zone does not

   expansion, none of those RRsets matches STYPE.  The name server MUST

   their associated RRSIG RRs:

   o  An NSEC RR proving that there are no RRsets matching STYPE at the
      wildcard owner name that matched <SNAME, SCLASS> via wildcard
      expansion.

   o  An NSEC RR proving that there are no RRsets in the zone that would
      have been a closer match for <SNAME, SCLASS>.

   In some cases, a single NSEC RR may prove both of these points.  If
   it does, the name server SHOULD only include the NSEC RR and its
   RRSIG RR(s) once in the Authority section.

   The owner names of these NSEC and RRSIG RRs are not subject to
   wildcard name expansion when these RRs are included in the Authority
   section of the response.
requirements.condition: The zone has no exact match for <SNAME, SCLASS>, but has RRsets matching <SNAME, SCLASS> through wildcard expansion, and none of those RRsets matches STYPE. The proof NSEC RRs are included in the Authority section of the response.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Apply wildcard name expansion to the owner names of these NSEC RRs.
requirements.why_checkable: The NSEC owner names on the wire can be compared with their zone owner names to detect wildcard expansion.

requirements.quote:
This case is a combination of the previous cases.  The zone does not
   contain an exact match for <SNAME, SCLASS>, and although the zone
   does contain RRsets that match <SNAME, SCLASS> via wildcard
   expansion, none of those RRsets matches STYPE.  The name server MUST

   o  An NSEC RR proving that there are no RRsets matching STYPE at the

   o  An NSEC RR proving that there are no RRsets in the zone that would

   it does, the name server SHOULD only include the NSEC RR and its
   RRSIG RR(s) once in the Authority section.

requirements.condition: The zone has no exact match for <SNAME, SCLASS>, but has RRsets matching <SNAME, SCLASS> through wildcard expansion, and none of those RRsets matches STYPE. Space does not permit inclusion of the required NSEC and RRSIG RRs.
requirements.required_behavior: The name server MUST set the response TC bit.
requirements.why_checkable: A response whose available space cannot hold the required proof records can be checked for TC equal to one.
